a4MicroSystemAccess: MakeCode extension for the A4 Technologie microSySTEM-Access model.
a4MicroSystemAccess.DoorSensorLevel: Electrical levels used to configure the door sensor.
a4MicroSystemAccess.DoorState: Door states reported by the microswitch.
a4MicroSystemAccess.clearEnteredCode: Clears all digits from the entered access code.
a4MicroSystemAccess.deleteLastCharacter: Deletes the last digit from the entered access code.
a4MicroSystemAccess.doorIs: Returns true when the door is in the selected state.
a4MicroSystemAccess.enteredCodeIs: Returns true when the entered access code matches the given code.
a4MicroSystemAccess.getEnteredCode:
Returns the digits entered since the code was last cleared.
The star key clears the code and the hash key is not appended.
a4MicroSystemAccess.initializeKeypad:
Initializes the capacitive keypad connected to P14 and P15.
The keypad uses the micro:bit serial port at 9600 baud.
a4MicroSystemAccess.keyAvailable: Returns true when at least one keypad key is waiting to be read.
a4MicroSystemAccess.lockDoor: Locks the door by energizing the magnetic lock connected to C0.
a4MicroSystemAccess.onKeyPressed: Runs code whenever a valid keypad key is pressed.
a4MicroSystemAccess.onKeyPressed|param|h: code to run; key is the pressed character
a4MicroSystemAccess.readKey: Returns the oldest unread keypad key, or an empty string when none is available.
a4MicroSystemAccess.setDoorClosedLevel:
Sets the electrical level produced by the sensor when the door is closed.
The microSySTEM-Access default is high.
a4MicroSystemAccess.setDoorClosedLevel|p: electrical level for a closed door
a4MicroSystemAccess.unlockDoor: Unlocks the door by switching off the magnetic lock connected to C0.
a4MicroSystemAccess.waitForKey: Waits for the next keypad key and returns it.
